newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randex in 22.6 mln rand sale to Harmony.
newsitem.headline: Randex in 22.6 mln rand sale to Harmony.

text.p: Randex Ltd said on Friday it had disposed of a stake in the Weltevreden Gold Mine Ltd as well as participation rights on a number of Free State farms to Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd for 22.6 million rand.
Randex said it had disposed of 270,000 shares in Weltevreden for which it would in turn receive 620,000 shares in Harmony.
It said the disposals were expected to increase the probability of the earlier exploitation of the rights.
Randex said it was inappropriate to calculate the effect of trhe disposal of earnings per share as its earnigs from Harmony would be dependent on Harmony's dividend policy.
It said that based on the closing Harmony share price on February 12 of 36.50 the disposal amount was estimated at 22.6 million rand.
